pricing_page.notes: Public page lists Enterprise and Enterprise Premier plans; pricing depends on daily active users and member seats.

product_one_liner.value: Luciq provides AI-powered mobile observability that helps mobile engineering teams detect, diagnose, prioritize, and resolve application crashes, performance problems, and user-experience issues.
